bio.text: Brian Cunningham represents the 43rd Assembly District in Central Brooklyn, including Crown Heights, Prospect Lefferts Gardens and Flatbush, and was elected in March 2022.
He was born and raised in New York City to Jamaican immigrant parents.
Before the Assembly he worked as a chief of staff in the New York City Council and as a special assistant in the New York State Senate, and ran a Cure Violence site in Central Brooklyn.
